articles.title: JPM stays constructive on French telcos with or without consolidation
articles.mainIdea: JPM stays constructive on French telcos with or without consolidation
articles.summary: Investing.com: JPM stays constructive on French telcos with or without consolidation. Investing.com -- J.P. Morgan maintained “overweight” ratings on Orange SA and Bouygues on Friday, arguing both stocks offer double-digit equity free cash flow compound annual growth rates on a standalone basis, even if a long-anticipated break-up of SFR fails to materialize. Related tickers mentioned: EN.PA, ORA.PA.
